title: HDMI_INSERT 16 x 18: U506 pin-18 ideal-diode island; FPC sockets OPEN (placeholders J1/J2)
note: W2 PCB-SB2. Outline and placement only (plan PCB-SB2: GR-4 added no FPC socket refs and no pass-through net set): the U506 (LM66100) pin-18 island with C517/C518/R552/TP502 in the MECH-4 reserve, and two placeholder lands J1/J2 for the pin-18 and GND contacts of the not-chosen FPC sockets, so the boundary audit is 'provisional' (OPEN with the GR-4 reason). The final pass-through (TMDS 100 ohm differential, length-matched) needs the socket MPN and pinout and becomes a 4-layer JLC04161H-7628 board (decision 'HDMI_INSERT - прохідна плата (W2 PCB-SB2)', build/15). CI/model output only; not a fabrication release; the HDMI link test stays OPEN.

layers.source: final-plan.json PCB-SB2 / A-PCB-10 decision: 2-layer 1.6 mm JLC standard for the small boards; decision 'Малі плати II: шари й мідь (W2 PCB-SB2)' in build/15

rules_note: The rules live in the committed project file, the same set as pcb/boards/HATCH.json and ENC (track 0.25 / clearance 0.2, minimum 0.15 / 0.15, via 0.6 / 0.3, copper-edge 0.3, hole-hole 0.5, hole clearance 0.25, text 1.0 / 0.15), plus the board net classes named in layers.plan. pcb/rules/jlc-2l.kicad_dru is not attached: pcb/board_gen.py refuses a non-null rules_file (validate_spec).

parts.why_placeholder: The boundary nets E5_HDMI_5V_Q6A, E5_HDMI_5V_DISP and GND leave the board through the two FPC sockets, which have no graph ref, no MPN and no published pinout (W2 GR-4). Two 2-pad 2.0 mm lands (KiCad 10.0.7 PinHeader_1x02_P2.00mm_Vertical, drill 0.8, pad 1.35) mark where the socket A / socket B pin-18 and GND contacts join the island, so the boundary audit reads 'provisional' (OPEN) instead of 'dangling'. Nothing is fitted in them; the TMDS, clock, DDC, CEC, HPD and shield conductors stay OPEN with the sockets.
